description: This source file provides functions for extracting and processing text from PDF and DOCX files, as well as parsing resume data to extract structured information such as name, email, phone, and skills.

methods.name: _clean_text
methods.description: Cleans up raw text by replacing null characters, collapsing whitespace, and normalizing newlines.

methods.name: extract_text_from_pdf
methods.description: Extracts text content from a PDF byte stream.

methods.name: extract_text_from_docx
methods.description: Extracts text content from a DOCX byte stream.

methods.name: extract_text
methods.description: Determines file type and extracts text accordingly, with fallback to utf-8 decoding.

methods.name: _find_emails
methods.description: Finds all email addresses in the given text.

methods.name: _find_phone
methods.description: Finds a phone number in the given text.

methods.name: _guess_name
methods.description: Naively guesses a person's name from the text based on line patterns.

methods.name: extract_structured_fields
methods.description: Produces a structured dictionary with name, emails, phone, skills, and summary from raw resume text.
